user_story: As a user, I want to filter tasks by completion status so that I can see only open or only done tasks.

positive.title: Filter tasks to show only open tasks
steps: Verify that the displayed tasks are only those marked as open
positive.expected_result: Only open tasks are displayed on the screen

positive.title: Filter tasks to show only done tasks
steps: Verify that the displayed tasks are only those marked as done
positive.expected_result: Only done tasks are displayed on the screen

negative.title: Attempt to filter tasks with invalid status
negative.expected_result: An error message indicating that the filter option is invalid is displayed

negative.title: Filter tasks when there are no tasks present
negative.expected_result: A message indicating no tasks are available is displayed

edge.title: Filter tasks when task completion statuses are mixed
steps: Navigate to the tasks page with multiple tasks of various statuses
edge.expected_result: Only open tasks are filtered and displayed correctly

edge.title: Filter tasks with no selection immediately after loading page
steps: Do not select any filter option
edge.expected_result: All tasks are displayed when no filter is applied
